scope: Scoped adapters; not funded-wallet E2E or independent security certification

publicEntries.name: Sui
publicEntries.note: Settlement layer: balances, stakes and transaction status read live. Plain coin transfers build + simulate in Noise; wallet signs. (No `objects` action: no HTTP surface exposes raw object listing.)

publicEntries.name: Sui Native Staking
publicEntries.note: Native validator staking: stake, unstake, rewards and validators.

publicEntries.name: Cetus
publicEntries.ref: partner closed to new teams → policy 0
publicEntries.note: Primary swap router: quote → build → simulate → wallet signing flow; signed E2E is not certified by this audit. No Cetus LP-position adapter exists, so no `position` capability is claimed.

publicEntries.name: Aftermath
publicEntries.note: Live data, unsigned swap and LP deposit/withdraw builders. Swap and LP deposit dry-run verified. Wallet signing and funded LP withdrawals require user E2E validation.

publicEntries.name: DeepBook
publicEntries.note: Sui's native onchain liquidity layer. Live markets, L2 orderbook, order build/cancel via BalanceManager.

publicEntries.name: DeepBook Predict
publicEntries.note: Live prediction markets: UP/DOWN mint, redeem, claim-settled, positions.

publicEntries.name: Turbos
publicEntries.note: Live pool reads and swaps via Cetus Aggregator restricted to TURBOS; each returned path is checked and must simulate before wallet signing. LP deposits are not included.

publicEntries.name: FlowX
publicEntries.note: In-hub swap quotes and PTBs via Cetus Aggregator restricted to FLOWX/FLOWXV3; every returned path is checked. No direct LP integration.

publicEntries.name: Momentum
publicEntries.note: In-hub swap quotes and PTBs via Cetus Aggregator restricted to MOMENTUM. Mainnet dry-run verified; direct LP integration is not included.

publicEntries.name: Bluefin Spot
publicEntries.note: Bluefin AMM spot swaps inside Noise via Cetus Aggregator restricted to BLUEFIN. This is not Bluefin perps or account-based orderbook execution.

publicEntries.name: NAVI
publicEntries.note: Only the listed in-hub operations are available. Each transaction requires successful fresh simulation and wallet signature.

publicEntries.name: Volo
publicEntries.note: Unsigned Volo stake/redeem PTBs; shared object types and protocol fees read on-chain. Stake and atomic stake/redeem dry-run verified; wallet signing remains user-controlled.

publicEntries.name: SpringSui
publicEntries.note: Only the listed in-hub operations are available. Each transaction requires successful fresh simulation and wallet signature.

publicEntries.name: Kai
publicEntries.note: SUI and USDC vault deposit/redeem only; no leveraged positions. APR/APY provider ratios converted to percentages.

publicEntries.name: STEAMM
publicEntries.note: Real STEAMM LP deposit/withdraw PTBs via official SDK, authoritative pool types, quoted minima and simulation gate. CP pool deposit/redeem dry-run verified. STEAMM swap routing is not enabled; oracle swaps require a separate Pyth Pro integration.

publicEntries.name: Wormhole / Portal
publicEntries.note: In-hub official bridge widget: quote, wallet signing, tracking and recovery. No Noise bridge fee. Real signed cross-chain E2E was not performed in this audit.
